heading: 8.7 Dimension propagation through `::` casts
text:
### 8.7 Dimension propagation through `::` casts [LUNI.8.7]

A `::` conversion cast ([LCST.4.5.2]) whose target is a unit symbol produces a
dimensioned value. The compiler must track that dimension through the
[LUNI.8.1]–[LUNI.8.4] expression checks exactly as it tracks the dimension of
a unit-typed slot ([LUNI.7.1]) or an inline unit literal ([LUNI.4.3]) — a
cast-to-unit result and a native value of that unit are indistinguishable for
every dimensional check.
